mapper.select: SELECT cmc.species_id, cmc.combo_morph_id, cmc.component_morph_id, mm.morph_name AS component_morph_name, cmc.required_expression, cmc.sort_order FROM combo_morph_component cmc INNER JOIN morph_master mm ON mm.species_id = cmc.species_id AND mm.morph_id = cmc.component_morph_id WHERE cmc.species_id = #{speciesId} AND cmc.combo_morph_id = #{comboMorphId} ORDER BY cmc.sort_order, cmc.component_morph_id
